answer_text: Cato Sockets do not support jumbo frames on Socket LAN ports. For a 9000-byte frame received on a LAN port: if the Do Not Fragment (DF) bit is not set, the Socket will accept the packet and fragment it to the 1500-byte Ethernet frame size; if the DF bit is set, the Socket drops the packet and sends an ICMP Fragmentation Needed message back to the sender.
